entries.zh: 剥去（衣物、皮毛）；解开、松脱
entries.en: to strip off, to undress; to untie, to loosen
entries.notes: 第二字「斥」与 desatar 义及 M/R 对音皆不贴，疑为「拆」「褪」一类字之误录；义据首字「剥」与西语双义词定。

entries.en: to bare the body, to strip off one's upper garment
to spawn, to lay eggs (of fish)

entries.zh: （蝇）产卵、下蛆；引申为放任滋蔓
entries.en: to lay eggs, to breed (of flies); to spread unchecked
entries.notes: 汉字「放肆」与「蝇产卵」义不侔，M/R 第二音 fū/zū 亦非「肆」之常读，疑原稿借字记音；义从西语栏。

entries.en: to disobey, to be rebellious; base, villainous
entries.notes: M 栏「huān Pùẽ」对单字「悖」不能密合，疑原稿并记「反悖」二音；「villaso」当为 villano 之讹写。

entries.en: to resist, to defy (one's elders or superiors)

entries.zh: 执拗乖僻，不听劝导（对长辈）
entries.en: stubborn and perverse; obstinately refusing to heed (elders)
unworthy (of one's forebears); degenerate, disobedient to kin

entries.zh: 顶撞、不听从、置之不理（原稿三字不成词）
entries.en: to pay no heed, to disobey; to talk back stubbornly
entries.notes: 「假強思」三字不成词，M/R 对音参差，仅据西语栏「no hacer caso」定其大意，字义不敢遽定。

entries.zh: 横行，胡作非为，不守规矩
entries.en: to run amok, to act outrageously; disorderly
to act arbitrarily, to do as one pleases; disorderly

entries.zh: 威猛、威严勇猛（与西语「违抗尊长」不合，疑为「违命」之讹）
entries.en: fierce and overbearing; (per Spanish) to defy a superior — columns disagree
entries.notes: 汉字「威猛」与「违抗尊长」义不相合，而 R 栏 ūy mèng 与「違命」更贴；四栏不能互证，存疑。

entries.en: idle, unoccupied; to wander at leisure
entries.notes: R 栏作 iên，与「游」对音不合，疑为误录；义据西语 desocupado 与 M 栏 iū 定。
「玲瓏」取空明通透、宽敞之义以合 anchuroso；M 栏第二字残缺。

entries.en: at leisure, idle, free of business
to skin, to flay; to strip off a hide
